name: Морской бой
description: @battleshipgame — Морской бой для двух игроков через личный mesh-чат и Canvas. Расставьте флот 10×10 вручную или автоматически. Оба игрока должны установить игру и запустить команду в DM.
author: MeshApp
codeLines: -- Морской бой: игра для двух игроков через Lua API MeshApp.
-- MeshApp invokes the global callbacks; the returned module also allows standalone validation.
local s, active, storage_key, timer_id = nil, false, nil, nil
local view = {hover = 0, side = 0, vertical = false, confirm = false, buttons = {}}
local draw, receive, negotiate, begin_round, resume, action
-- Rules: cells are 1..100 internally, 00..99 on the wire.
return type(v) == "number" and v == math.floor(v) and v >= lo and v <= hi
local function xy(cell) return (cell - 1) % 10, math.floor((cell - 1) / 10) end
for i, ship in ipairs(ships) do
for _, cell in ipairs(ship) do cells[cell] = i end
local function candidate(ships, cell, length, vertical)
if not integer(cell, 1, 100) or not integer(length, 1, 4) then return nil end
if (vertical and y + length > 10) or (not vertical and x + length > 10) then return nil end
local cx, cy = x + (vertical and 0 or n), y + (vertical and n or 0)
local nx, ny = cx + dx, cy + dy
if nx >= 0 and nx < 10 and ny >= 0 and ny < 10 and used[ny * 10 + nx + 1] then return nil end
if type(ships) ~= "table" or #ships > #FLEET or (not partial and #ships ~= #FLEET) then return false end
for i, ship in ipairs(ships) do
if type(ship) ~= "table" or #ship ~= FLEET[i] or not integer(ship[1],1,100) then return false end
if not expected then return false end
for n, cell in ipairs(ship) do if cell ~= expected[n] then return false end end
-- Bounded enumeration, not an unbounded retry loop. The fallback is always legal.
local ship = candidate(ships, cell, length, orientation == 2)
if ship then choices[#choices + 1] = ship end
for _, value in ipairs(grid) do if value == "H" or value == "K" then n = n + 1 end end
for _, cell in ipairs(ship) do if shots[cell] == "." then alive = true end end
if alive then count = count + 1 end
for _, cell in ipairs(cells) do parts[#parts + 1] = string.format("%02d", cell - 1) end
if #value < 2 or #value > 8 or #value % 2 ~= 0 or not value:match("^%d+$") then return nil end
if seen[cell] then return nil end
if step ~= 1 and step ~= 10 then return nil end
if cells[i] ~= cells[1] + (i - 1) * step then return nil end
if step == 1 and math.floor((cells[i] - 1) / 10) ~= math.floor((cells[1] - 1) / 10) then return nil end
-- Persistence and transport. Every state change is committed before its packet is sent.
if s and storage_key then mesh.kv.set(storage_key, mesh.json.encode(s)) end
-- LuaJ formats large floats in scientific notation even with %.0f.
-- A nonnumeric prefix also preserves tokens through mesh.json (LuaJ treats numeric strings as numbers).
local function is_token(value) return type(value) == "string" and #value == 14 and value:match("^t%d+$") ~= nil end
local function leader() return s.owner < s.peer end
local function role(local_player) return (local_player == leader()) and "a" or "b" end
local function wire(sid, kind, id, body)
return table.concat({PREFIX, sid, kind, id, body or ""}, "|")
local function key(sid, id) return sid .. ":" .. id end
return string.lower(tostring(owner.node_id or "")) == s.owner and (owner.connection_id or "") == s.connection
if not active or #packet > MAX_PACKET or not same_connection() then return false end
local ok, result = pcall(mesh.chat.send_dm, s.peer, packet)
local function enqueue(kind, body, sid, id)
sid, id = sid or s.sid, id or new_id()
s.outbox[k] = {sid = sid, kind = kind, id = id, body = body or "", attempts = 0, at = 0}
if not entry then return end
if not transmit(wire(entry.sid, entry.kind, entry.id, entry.body)) then
s.notice = "Отправка не удалась. Повторим через 20 секунд."
local function ack(sid, id) transmit(wire(sid, "A", id, "")) end
for k, entry in pairs(s.outbox) do if entry.kind == kind then s.outbox[k] = nil end end
for _, entry in pairs(s.outbox) do if not kind or entry.kind == kind then return true end end
local function remember(sid, kind, id, body, response)
s.seen[key(sid, id)] = {kind = kind, body = body, response = response}
if entry.attempts >= MAX_ATTEMPTS and mesh.now() - entry.at >= RETRY_SECONDS then return true end
s.pending_shot, s.sync, s.restore_choice, s.sync_error = nil, false, false, false
local function record(cell, result, cells, shooter)
local event = table.concat({tostring(s.ply), shooter, tostring(cell), result, cells}, ",")
for i = 1, #event do s.digest = (s.digest * 131 + string.byte(event, i)) % 2147483647 end
if result == "M" then s.turn = shooter == "a" and "b" or "a" end
if s.phase == "placing" and s.ready and s.peer_ready then
s.phase, s.turn, s.notice = "playing", "a", "Оба флота готовы. Первым ходит игрок с меньшим ID ноды."
-- Keep only the previous round's rematch handshake until its ACK arrives.
for k, entry in pairs(s.outbox or {}) do if entry.kind == "N" then outbox[k] = entry end end
for k, entry in pairs(s.seen or {}) do if entry.kind == "N" and k:sub(1, #s.sid + 1) == s.sid .. ":" then seen[k] = entry end end
local owner, peer, name, peer_name, connection = s.owner, s.peer, s.name, s.peer_name, s.connection
s = {version = 1, owner = owner, peer = peer, name = name, peer_name = peer_name, connection = connection,
phase = "lobby", token = local_token, peer_token = peer_token or "", peer_watermark = watermark,
sid = "", seq = 0, ships = {}, own = blank(), enemy = blank(), enemy_sunk = {},
ready = false, peer_ready = false, ply = 1, turn = "a", history = {}, digest = 0,
outbox = outbox, seen = seen, sync = false, restore_choice = false,
notice = "Ожидаем второго игрока. На его устройстве тоже запустите " .. HANDLE}
if s.phase ~= "lobby" or not is_token(s.peer_token) then return end
if not leader() then first, second = second, first end
if s.sid ~= "" and s.sid ~= sid then return end
if leader() and not has_pending("I") then
if s.next_token and s.peer_next_token then begin_round(s.next_token, s.peer_next_token) end
-- A public transcript fingerprint is sufficient for conservative recovery; it is not a cheat-proof commitment.
if not leader() then a, b = b, a end
return table.concat({tostring(s.ply), tostring(s.digest), s.turn, a and "1" or "0", b and "1" or "0", s.winner or "-", s.reason or "-"}, ",")
local ply, digest, turn, ra, rb, winner, reason = body:match("^(%d+),(%d+),([ab]),([01]),([01]),([ab%-]),([a-z%-]+)$")
and (reason == "-" or reason == "fleet" or reason == "surrender" or reason == "aborted")
for _, entry in pairs(s.outbox) do entry.attempts, entry.at = 0, mesh.now() - RETRY_SECONDS end
s.notice = "Сверяем состояние с соперником. Ходы временно остановлены."
local k = enqueue("U", summary(), s.sid, s.sync_token)
return active and s and s.phase == "playing" and not s.sync and not s.restore_choice
and not s.pending_shot and s.turn == role(true) and not has_pending("R") and not has_pending("D") and not failed()
if not can_fire() or not integer(cell, 1, 100) or s.enemy[cell] ~= "." then return false end
s.pending_shot = {id = id, cell = cell, ply = s.ply}
local k = enqueue("S", tostring(s.ply) .. "," .. tostring(cell), nil, id)
if s.phase ~= "playing" or s.sync or s.pending_shot or s.turn ~= role(false)
or ply ~= s.ply or not integer(cell, 1, 100) or s.own[cell] ~= "." then return false end
for _, c in ipairs(s.ships[ship_index]) do if s.own[c] == "." then sunk = false end end
for _, c in ipairs(s.ships[ship_index]) do s.own[c] = "K" end
-- A subsequent valid shot proves receipt of the previous result even if its ACK was lost.
s.notice = "Соперник стрелял в " .. coord(cell) .. ": " .. ({M="мимо",H="попадание",K="корабль потоплен",W="флот уничтожен"})[result]
local response_body = table.concat({id, tostring(ply), tostring(cell), result, cells}, ",")
local k = enqueue("R", response_body, nil, response_id)
remember(s.sid, "S", id, body, {id = response_id, body = response_body})
-- The result itself acknowledges the shot: there is no separate shot ACK.
local shot_id, ply_text, cell_text, result, cells_text = body:match("^([ab]%d+),(%d+),(%d+),([MHKW]),(%d*)$")
if s.sync or not p or shot_id ~= p.id or tonumber(ply_text) ~= p.ply or tonumber(cell_text) ~= p.cell then return false end
if s.phase ~= "playing" or s.ply ~= p.ply or s.turn ~= role(true) then return false end
if cells_text ~= "" or (result == "H" and hits >= 19) then return false end
if not cells then return false end
for _, c in ipairs(ship) do previously_sunk[c] = true end
if count_length >= limits[#cells] then return false end
if c == p.cell then includes = true
elseif s.enemy[c] ~= "H" then return false end
if previously_sunk[c] then return false end
if math.abs(x-sx) <= 1 and math.abs(y-sy) <= 1 then return false end
if not includes or ((result == "W") ~= (hits + 1 == 20)) or (result == "W" and #s.enemy_sunk ~= 9) then return false end
for _, c in ipairs(cells) do s.enemy[c] = "K" end
s.notice = coord(p.cell) .. ": " .. ({M="мимо. Ход соперника.", H="попадание! Стреляйте ещё.", K="потоплен! Стреляйте ещё.", W="победа! Весь флот соперника уничтожен."})[result]
if type(packet) ~= "string" or #packet > MAX_PACKET then return end
if not sid or #id > 14 or #body > 100 then return end
if kind ~= "H" and kind ~= "U" and not id:match("^[ab]%d+$") and kind ~= "A" then return end
if kind ~= "H" and kind ~= "U" and kind ~= "A" and id:sub(1,1) ~= role(false) then return end
if not entry or body ~= "" or entry.kind == "S" or entry.kind == "H" or entry.kind == "U" then return end
-- Exact duplicates may be acknowledged even while frozen; conflicting reuse of an ID is rejected.
if seen.kind ~= kind or seen.body ~= body then return end
if sid == s.sid then transmit(wire(sid, seen.response.kind or "R", seen.response.id, seen.response.body)) end
if sid ~= "-" or body ~= "" or not is_token(id) or s.phase ~= "lobby" then return end
if id < s.peer_watermark then return end
-- An unaccepted invitation may be replaced after the other player cancels/restarts it.
-- Once I is accepted, phase=placing prevents this from replacing an agreed game.
if first_hello and not leader() then
if s.outbox[k] then s.outbox[k].attempts = 0; send_entry(k) end
if leader() or s.phase ~= "lobby" or body ~= "" or not is_token(first) or second ~= s.token then return end
if (s.peer_token ~= "" and s.peer_token ~= first) or first < s.peer_watermark then return end
s.sid, s.peer_token, s.peer_watermark = sid, first, first
if sid ~= s.sid or sid == "" then return end
if not is_token(id) or not valid_summary(body) or (s.last_peer_sync and id <= s.last_peer_sync) then return end
s.sync, s.sync_error, s.notice = true, true, "Состояния различаются. Завершите старую партию и начните новую."
local k = enqueue("V", response_body, sid, response_id)
remember(sid, kind, id, body, {kind="V", id=response_id, body=response_body})
if not is_token(request) or not valid_summary(remote) then return end
if not pending or pending.kind ~= "U" then
-- A response to an abandoned recovery attempt must stop retrying, never resume that attempt.
if s.sync_token and request <= s.sync_token then ack(sid, id) end
if request ~= s.sync_token then return end
if remote ~= pending.body or remote ~= summary() then
s.sync, s.sync_error, s.notice = true, true, "Состояния различаются. Завершите старую партию и начните новую."
s.sync, s.sync_error, s.notice = false, false, "Состояния согласованы. Игра восстановлена."
for _, entry in pairs(s.outbox) do entry.attempts, entry.at = 0, mesh.now() - RETRY_SECONDS end
s.notice = "Старая партия завершена. Новая начнётся после согласия обоих игроков."
if body ~= "" or (s.phase ~= "playing" and s.reason ~= "surrender" and s.reason ~= "fleet") then return end
if s.surrendered then winner = "a" end -- simultaneous surrender, independent of ACK order
for k, entry in pairs(s.outbox) do if entry.kind ~= "Q" then s.outbox[k] = nil end end
if body ~= "" or s.peer_ready or (s.phase ~= "placing" and s.phase ~= "playing") then return end
elseif kind == "S" then process_shot(id, body); return
elseif kind == "R" then process_result(id, body); return
if s.phase ~= "finished" or not is_token(body) then return end
s.notice = "Соперник предлагает новую партию. Нажмите «Новая партия», чтобы согласиться."
-- User actions are shared by Canvas and the test harness.
if not active or not s or not same_connection() then return false end
if name == "resume" and s.restore_choice then resume()
elseif name == "abort" and (s.restore_choice or s.sync or s.phase == "lobby") then
elseif name == "retry" and not s.sync_error then
for _, entry in pairs(s.outbox) do entry.attempts, entry.at = 0, mesh.now() - RETRY_SECONDS end

if s.phase == "finished" then s.notice = "Запрос отправлен. Ожидаем согласия соперника." end
elseif name == "surrender" and s.phase == "playing" then view.confirm = true
elseif name == "confirm" and view.confirm and s.phase == "playing" then
elseif s.phase == "placing" and not s.ready then
elseif name == "rotate" then view.vertical = not view.vertical
local ship = candidate(s.ships, value, FLEET[#s.ships + 1], view.vertical)
if not ship then s.notice = "Здесь корабль не помещается или касается другого корабля."; draw(); return false end
s.ready, s.notice = true, "Флот зафиксирован. Ожидаем готовность соперника."

sea="#122b3d", grid="#2b4659", blue="#408fc0", teal="#48d4bd", red="#ee7181", gold="#f3bc6a"}
for char in tostring(value or ""):gmatch("[%z\1-\127\194-\244][\128-\191]*") do
if #parts == limit then return table.concat(parts) .. "…" end

mesh.canvas.fill_text(value, x, y, color or C.text)

mesh.canvas.stroke_round_rect(x, y, w, h, 10, enabled and C.grid or C.border, 1)
label(text, x + 12, y + 26, name == "retry" and 12 or 14, enabled and C.text or C.muted, true)

mesh.canvas.stroke_rect(bx+x*36+2, by+y*36+2, 32, 32, allowed and C.teal or C.muted, 2)
or (s.peer_ready and "Соперник готов" or "Соперник готовит флот"), panel_x+20, 635, 13, C.muted)

or "Все корабли расставлены. Нажмите «Готов», чтобы зафиксировать флот."

local function load_state(raw, owner, peer, connection)
if not raw then return nil end
if type(value) ~= "table" or value.version ~= 1 or value.owner ~= owner or value.peer ~= peer or value.connection ~= connection then return nil end
or not is_token(value.token) or type(value.outbox) ~= "table" or type(value.seen) ~= "table"
or type(value.ships) ~= "table" or type(value.enemy_sunk) ~= "table" or type(value.history) ~= "table"
or type(value.own) ~= "table" or #value.own ~= 100 or type(value.enemy) ~= "table" or #value.enemy ~= 100
or not integer(value.ply,1,201) or not integer(value.digest,0,2147483646)
or not integer(value.seq,0,10000) or type(value.sid) ~= "string" then return nil end
or (value.turn ~= "a" and value.turn ~= "b") or not valid_fleet(value.ships, not value.ready) then return nil end
or not ({["."]=true,M=true,H=true,K=true})[value.enemy[i]] then return nil end
for k, entry in pairs(value.outbox) do
if type(k) ~= "string" or type(entry) ~= "table" or type(entry.kind) ~= "string"
or type(entry.sid) ~= "string" or type(entry.id) ~= "string" or type(entry.body) ~= "string"
or not integer(entry.attempts,0,MAX_ATTEMPTS) or type(entry.at) ~= "number" then return nil end
for k, entry in pairs(value.seen) do
if type(k) ~= "string" or type(entry) ~= "table" or type(entry.kind) ~= "string" or type(entry.body) ~= "string" then return nil end
or type(entry.response.body) ~= "string") then return nil end
if value.pending_shot and (type(value.pending_shot) ~= "table" or not integer(value.pending_shot.cell,1,100)
or value.pending_shot.ply ~= value.ply or type(value.pending_shot.id) ~= "string") then return nil end
mesh.chat.bot_message(command.chat_type, command.chat_key, "Морской бой запускается только в личном чате: " .. HANDLE)
local own_id, peer = string.lower(tostring(owner.node_id or "")), string.lower(tostring(command.chat_key or ""))
if own_id == "" or peer == "" or own_id == peer then
mesh.chat.bot_message("dm", command.chat_key, "Подключите свою ноду и выберите личный чат с другим игроком.")
if s.owner ~= own_id or s.peer ~= peer then

s = load_state(raw, own_id, peer, owner.connection_id or "")
if id == own_id then s.name = node.long_name or node.short_name or own_id end
if id == peer then s.peer_name = node.long_name or node.short_name or peer end
